description_en: Submit Individual Information of an A-number mobile phone number through an API
description_zh: 通过API提交A号码手机号个人信息报备
name: CreatePhoneNoAReport

parameters.help_en: ID of the A-number group. On the Qualification Management (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/qualification) page, click View Details in the A-number whitelist section of the relevant qualification.
parameters.help_zh: 所属A号码组ID。在资质管理 (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/qualification)页面所属资质的A号码白名单栏单击查看详情
parameters.name: ano_white_group_id

parameters.help_en: Certificate type. Enter 1 for an ID card.
parameters.help_zh: 证件类型，填写1表示身份证
parameters.name: document_type

parameters.help_en: OSS path of the photo of the front side (national emblem side) of the ID card.
parameters.help_zh: 身份证正面（国徽面）照片OSS路径地址
parameters.name: id_card_front_photo

parameters.help_en: OSS path of the photo of the back side (portrait side) of the ID card.
parameters.help_zh: 身份证反面（人像面）照片OSS路径地址
parameters.name: id_card_back_photo

parameters.help_en: OSS path of the front-facing portrait photo
parameters.help_zh: 正面人像照片OSS路径地址
parameters.name: id_card_alive_photo

parameters.help_en: Remark (business remark added by the user).
parameters.help_zh: 备注（用户自身的业务备注）
